n79463a87b4.headline: CRESUD S.A.C.I.F. y A. announces its results for the second quarter of Fiscal Year 2024 ended December 31, 2023
n79463a87b4.summary: Argentine agricultural company Cresud S.A.C.I.F. y A. has announced its results for the second quarter of fiscal 2024, ended December 31, 2023.
n79463a87b4.why: Cresud is an Argentine agribusiness and real estate company listed on Nasdaq and the Buenos Aires exchange, so its results reflect farming conditions in Argentina.

n507590c8e4.headline: China's Central Bank Plans To Boost Affordable Housing, Infrastructure Investment
n507590c8e4.summary: The People's Bank of China said it aims to use its monetary instruments better to support affordable housing and other infrastructure investment, as the economy grows.
n507590c8e4.why: The PBOC is China's central bank, and its lending tools shape credit conditions for property and infrastructure, which are key growth drivers.

nbd2c8709ca.headline: Banca Mediolanum dividend up 40 percent; January net inflows fall
nbd2c8709ca.summary: Banca Mediolanum shared January net inflow figures and approved 2023 consolidated results. It proposed a balance dividend of EUR0.42 per share, up 40%.
nbd2c8709ca.why: Banca Mediolanum is an Italian private bank and wealth manager whose dividend and net inflows show the health of its savings and advisory business.

nb56043ad34.headline: Mexican customs system 'glitches' cause freight delays
nb56043ad34.summary: Glitches in the Mexican customs office computer system are causing freight delays, including at the Nuevo Laredo freight crossing used for import-exports.
nb56043ad34.why: Nuevo Laredo is one of the busiest US-Mexico freight crossings, so customs delays raise logistics costs for North American manufacturers.

nc252746f09.headline: FleetCor’s Q4 revenue and profit rise y/y but miss analysts’ estimates
nc252746f09.summary: FleetCor reported fourth-quarter fleet transaction revenue of $108 million, down 19% year on year. Revenue and profit rose overall but missed analysts' estimates.
nc252746f09.why: FleetCor is a US provider of fuel and payment cards for commercial fleets, so its results reflect transport and fuel spending trends.

nc9bb095bdb.headline: No price spikes, supply issues in JB due to influx of Singaporeans, says Johor official
nc9bb095bdb.summary: A Johor official said there are no price spikes or supply issues in Johor Bahru despite an influx of Singaporeans. Petrol station owners were urged to act on foreign-registered vehicles buying subsidised fuel.
nc9bb095bdb.why: Malaysia's fuel subsidies keep domestic petrol prices below market levels, so cross-border buying affects state spending and local fuel supply.

n31d11483db.headline: Spectrum Brands Holdings Reports Fiscal 2024 First Quarter Results
n31d11483db.summary: Spectrum Brands reported net sales down 3.0%, driven by lower consumer demand in North American small kitchen appliances and SKU rationalizations. Favorable currency and pricing partly offset the decline.
n31d11483db.why: Spectrum Brands is a consumer products company selling household and pet products and small appliances, and its results signal demand trends in consumer goods.

nb1c204b262.headline: Japan's Cosmo expects around 90% refinery run rate in 2024/25
nb1c204b262.summary: Cosmo Energy Holdings expects its refinery run rate to hover around 90% in the business year starting in April, with maintenance shutdowns planned at its Chiba and other refineries.
nb1c204b262.why: Cosmo Energy is a Japanese refiner and fuel marketer, so its refinery utilisation affects domestic fuel supply and margins.

nc1ed5df26f.headline: South African rand steady ahead of manufacturing data, president's speech
nc1ed5df26f.summary: The South African rand was little changed in early trade on Thursday, trading at 18.9000 against the dollar, ahead of manufacturing production figures and President Ramaphosa's annual address.
nc1ed5df26f.why: The rand is South Africa's main currency, and its moves influence import costs, inflation and the country's financial markets.

n1ac9c0fe9b.headline: Zimmer Biomet Announces Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2023 Financial Results
n1ac9c0fe9b.summary: Zimmer Biomet reported fourth-quarter net sales of $1.940 billion, up 6.3%, and adjusted diluted EPS of $2.20. Full-year 2023 results were also released.
n1ac9c0fe9b.why: Zimmer Biomet is a major US maker of orthopaedic implants and surgical devices, so its results reflect demand for joint and surgical procedures.

n98bb0f49c8.headline: Five key things to watch for in South African President’s keynote speech
n98bb0f49c8.summary: President Cyril Ramaphosa will deliver his last state-of-the-nation address before national elections described as the most hotly contested since apartheid ended. He is expected to take stock of his administration's work.
n98bb0f49c8.why: The State of the Nation address sets out the government's economic and policy agenda, which matters to investors ahead of an election.

nae784c569c.headline: Stock markets tumble 1 per cent after RBI monetary policy decision; bank stocks drag
nae784c569c.summary: Sensex and Nifty fell around 1% in Mumbai, dragged by banking and auto shares, as uncertainty grew over the timing of rate cuts after the RBI policy decision.
nae784c569c.why: The Reserve Bank of India sets interest rates for India's economy, and rate expectations directly affect bank margins and borrowing-sensitive sectors such as autos.
nae784c569c.why_moved: Investors grew more uncertain about when interest-rate cuts would come after the RBI policy decision, and banking and auto shares were sold.

nd47d1e78d7.headline: Question marks over China's economy have stocks on a long downward slide
nd47d1e78d7.summary: Benchmark Chinese indexes are near a five-year low after a rough start to the year. The CSI 300 is down nearly 20% over the past 12 months, with analysts citing bigger underlying problems.
nd47d1e78d7.why: The CSI 300 tracks the 300 largest stocks listed in Shanghai and Shenzhen and is a key gauge of mainland Chinese equity sentiment.

n9b7ddfa509.headline: WEX Inc. Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2023 Financial Results
n9b7ddfa509.summary: WEX Inc. reported fourth-quarter revenue up 7% year on year to a record $663 million. Benefits revenue grew 27% and Corporate Payments grew 22%.
n9b7ddfa509.why: WEX is a US payments company providing fleet, benefits and corporate payment services. Its segment growth indicates demand for its payment processing products.

ne0455d5adf.headline: Piquadro improves nine-month sales, drops only for Lancel
ne0455d5adf.summary: Piquadro reported nine-month revenues of EUR131.5 million, up from EUR126.8 million a year earlier. Sales at its Lancel unit fell over the same period.
ne0455d5adf.why: Piquadro is an Italian maker of leather goods and accessories. Its results reflect demand for mid-range luxury and accessories in Europe.

nee988c20dc.headline: Stripe rival Adyen's shares soar 22% as European payments giant posts profit beat, slows hiring
nee988c20dc.summary: Shares of Dutch payments company Adyen rose sharply after it reported strong sales growth and better-than-expected 2023 profit. The firm also said it is slowing hiring.
nee988c20dc.why: Adyen is a European online payments processor that serves large merchants, and it is often compared with US rival Stripe.

n1d5b291716.summary: The Reserve Bank of India said all lenders must list charges such as processing and documentation fees in the Key Fact Statement on loans. The move aims to increase transparency for borrowers.
n1d5b291716.why: The Reserve Bank of India is the central bank that regulates lending in India. Loan disclosure rules affect bank and non-bank lenders' pricing and compliance costs.

ne7697c59c8.headline: StarHub's net profit soared 140% to 150 million yuan last year, will distribute a final dividend of 4.2 cents per share
ne7697c59c8.summary: Singapore-based telecom company StarHub's net profit rose 140.4% last year to 149.6 million yuan, compared to 62.2 million yuan previously, and announced a final dividend of 4.2 cents per share.
ne7697c59c8.why: StarHub is a major telecom operator in Singapore; strong earnings growth and dividend announcements can influence investor sentiment and sector valuations.

n6f42437404.summary: Militant attacks occurred during Pakistan's general election, with mobile and border closures affecting political stability and investor sentiment.
